title: Kris Baumgartner
intro: I build small, expressive things for the web, with a bias toward systems that feel good to use and easy to keep changing.
body: This site is part blog, part workbench: a place for notes on code, interfaces, tools, and the odd little decisions that make software feel alive.
I like calm design, playful interaction, and codebases that make their shape clear without needing a map.
